verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own docs state users can pick different default desktop environments, apps, and settings backed by the full archive, directly supporting the story, but this is a single vendor claim not elaborated with specifics on official variants (e.g., Kubuntu, Xubuntu). Community evidence discusses various desktop environments (Unity, GNOME, KDE, XFCE, Compiz) used with Ubuntu but doesn't confirm an official variant-selection mechanism, leaving the claim under-verified by hands-on sources.
